# package enip

```go
import "github.com/otfabric/go-otfp/protocols/enip"
```

Package enip fingerprints EtherNet/IP (the CIP encapsulation of ODVA) over TCP and UDP.

Detection sends a ListIdentity command (0x0063), which needs no session and which every EtherNet/IP target answers with its CIP Identity object: vendor, device type, product code, revision, serial number and product name. Over UDP it is a single datagram; over TCP the encapsulation header is validated and the CPF identity item decoded. The command identifier is echoed, the status must be success and the sender context must match, so unrelated services do not match.

ListIdentity already carries the full identity, so detect and identify modes send the same probe; identify mode adds the vendor and device-type names and, over TCP, a RegisterSession to confirm the session layer.
